plant.plant_name.text: Name used in plots and reports. (Default: "".)

plant.process_type.text: "Solids", "Fluids", or "Mixed" — sets default cost factors. (Default: required.)

plant.country.text: Country for location factor lookup. (Default: "United States".)

plant.region.text: Region within the country (required for countries with regional factors). (Default: "Gulf Coast".)

plant.loc_factor.text: Direct location factor override. Bypasses country/region lookup. (Default: None.)

plant.currency.text: Currency label for display. Use $ when using symbol to avoid RST syntax errors. (Default: "USD".)

plant.exchange_rate.text: Conversion from USD to currency (1 USD = exchange_rate × currency unit). (Default: 1.0.)

plant.interest_rate.text: Discount rate for NPV, capital recovery, and working-capital interest. (Default: 0.09.)

plant.project_lifetime.text: Project duration in years (integer ≥ 3). Accepts an array for scenario analysis. (Default: 20.)

plant.plant_utilization.text: Annual capacity utilization (0–1). Scales production and variable OPEX. (Default: 1.0.)

plant.tax_rate.text: Corporate income tax rate (0–1). Not applied to levelized cost calculations. (Default: 0.)

plant.working_capital.text: Working capital in USD. Defaults to 0.15 × FCI when None. (Default: None.)

plant.plant_products.text: Products dict. First entry is the main product for LCOP; others are co-products. Each entry takes production (units/day) and price (USD/unit), plus the optional Monte Carlo keys price_uncertainty, production_uncertainty, and production_dependency — see uncertainty-keys. (Default: {}.)

plant.variable_opex_inputs.text: Utilities and raw materials, each with consumption (units/day) and price (USD/unit), plus the optional Monte Carlo keys price_uncertainty, consumption_uncertainty, and consumption_dependency — see uncertainty-keys. (Default: {}.)

plant.project_uncertainties.text: Per-parameter uncertainty for the six project-level scalars (fixed_capital_factor, fixed_opex_factor, project_lifetime, interest_rate, plant_utilization, tax_rate). Read by monte_carlo() only — see uncertainty-keys. (Default: {}.)

plant.operator_hourly_rate.text: Operator wage in USD/hr, under "rate". Monte Carlo uncertainty goes in a nested "rate_uncertainty" sub-dict (same fields as price_uncertainty; the legacy flat layout still works). Also accepts the dependency key of a project-level scalar. (Default: {"rate": 38.11}.)

plant.operating_shifts_per_day.text: Daily operating shifts (continuous plants typically run 3). (Default: 3.)

plant.operators_hired.text: Total headcount. Computed automatically from process type; override to fix. (Default: auto.)

plant.operators_per_shift.text: Operators per shift. Computed automatically; override to fix. (Default: auto.)

plant.production_type.text: "continuous" or "batch". Only affects the auto-calculated operators_per_shift (applies the chart's minimum of 3 operators/shift for batch processes); does not change capital, OPEX, or cash-flow calculations elsewhere. (Default: "continuous".)

plant.fixed_capital_factors.text: Per-key overrides for OSBL, D&E, and contingency factors. (Default: {}.)

plant.fixed_capital_components.text: Absolute cost overrides for any FCI component (takes precedence over factors). (Default: {}.)

plant.fixed_opex_factors.text: Per-key factor overrides for fixed OPEX components. (Default: {}.)

plant.fixed_opex_components.text: Absolute cost overrides for any fixed OPEX component. (Default: {}.)

plant.capex_ramp.text: CAPEX spending fractions by construction year (must sum to 1.0). (Default: [0.3, 0.6, 0.1].)

plant.production_ramp.text: Capacity fractions by project year. Years beyond the list default to 1.0. (Default: [0, 0, 0.4, 0.8].)

plant.depreciation.text: Depreciation settings (method, life, etc.) — see depreciation. (Default: {}.)

equipment.name.text: Identifier for this equipment item (used in plots and reports).

equipment.param.text: Size/capacity parameter. Units depend on the equipment type — check cost_correlations.csv. Pass a 2-element (S1, S2) tuple/list for two-parameter forms such as "2-var power-law" (see Example 10). Ignored when purchased_cost is given.

equipment.process_type.text: "Solids", "Fluids", "Mixed", or "Electrical" — controls default installation factor values.

equipment.category.text: Equipment category — must match a row in cost_correlations.csv (case-insensitive).

equipment.type.text: Equipment sub-type within the category. Required when a category has multiple types.

equipment.material.text: Construction material. Default: None, which uses the resolved correlation's default material (falling back to "Carbon steel" if there's no match). A material that matches this resolved default — whether auto-filled or passed explicitly — always gets f_m = 1.0, since the correlation's cost already prices that material in. Passing a different material instead uses the ratio of the two materials' factors from the table below (target f_m divided by default f_m, using 1.0 for a default material not in the table, e.g. "Cast iron"), so the factor stays relative to the correlation's actual cost basis instead of double-counting it. Raises if the target material isn't found in the table.

equipment.target_year.text: Year to inflate costs to. Default: 2024.

equipment.purchased_cost.text: Supply your own purchased cost (the total for all units) and bypass the correlation entirely.

equipment.cost_year.text: Reference year of a manually supplied purchased_cost. If given, CEPCI inflation is applied from this year to target_year.

equipment.cost_func.text: Explicit correlation key (the key column in the CSV). Use this to select a specific correlation when multiple exist for the same category/type.

equipment.num_units.text: Number of identical units. With a correlation, param describes one unit and the correlation cost is multiplied by num_units. With a manual purchased_cost it is a label only (the cost is the total). By default it is 1 for a manual purchased_cost, or the number of parallel units the parallelization logic splits param into (that cost already covers all of them).

equipment.piping_factor.text: Per-factor overrides. None uses the process_type default.

equipment.erection_factor.text: Per-factor overrides. None uses the process_type default.

equipment.lagging_factor.text: Per-factor overrides. None uses the process_type default.

equipment.material_factor.text: Override the material factor. None uses 1.0 when material matches the resolved default, or the ratio of the two materials' table factors otherwise.

composite.process_type.text: "Solids", "Fluids", "Mixed", or "Electrical". Used by the plant's operator estimate and, under the "composite" installation rule, as the factor table for the whole composite.

composite.components.text: Equipment or CompositeEquipment objects. Several identical units of a component are priced by setting num_units on the component itself, exactly as for stand-alone equipment.

composite.category.text: Free labels used for reporting. Default category is "Composite".

composite.type.text: Free labels used for reporting. Default category is "Composite".

composite.installation.text: "component" (default): the direct cost is the sum of each component's own direct cost, so every part keeps its own process-type and material factors. "composite": the composite's own process-type factors are applied once to the total purchased cost, i.e. the assembly is installed as one item.

composite.purchased_cost.text: Optional vendor quote for the whole composite (the total for all num_units, not multiplied). It replaces the component sum, which is kept as components_purchased_cost; the composite is then installed as one item.

composite.cost_year.text: Optional vendor quote for the whole composite (the total for all num_units, not multiplied). It replaces the component sum, which is kept as components_purchased_cost; the composite is then installed as one item.

composite.num_units.text: Number of identical composites. Multiplies the component-based purchased and direct cost. Default 1.

composite.target_year.text: Must match every component's target_year. Default 2024.

composite.piping_factor.text: Overrides used by the "composite" installation rule.

composite.material_factor.text: Overrides used by the "composite" installation rule.

project_uncertainty.fixed_capital_factor.text: Multiplicative factor on total installed CAPEX. (Default std: 0.30 (30%).)

project_uncertainty.fixed_opex_factor.text: Multiplicative factor on annual fixed OPEX. (Default std: 0.30 (30%).)

project_uncertainty.plant_utilization.text: Yearly fraction of operating time. (Default std: 0 (opt-in).)

dist.0.text: Fixed value — loc — No randomness; every draw equals loc.

dist.1.text: Fixed value — loc — No randomness; every draw equals loc.

dist.2.text: Lognormal — loc (μ), scale (σ) — Optional min/max truncate the drawn samples.

dist.3.text: Normal (default) — loc (mean), scale (std) — Optional min/max truncate the drawn samples.

dist.6.text: Bernoulli — loc (probability p), scale (success value, default 1) — Draws are 0 or scale. Optional min/max truncate.

dist.7.text: Discrete uniform — min, max — Integers, inclusive of max.

dist.10.text: Beta — loc (α), shape (β), max (upper bound, default 1)

dist.11.text: Generalized extreme value (GEV) — loc (μ), scale (σ), shape (ξ)

dist.12.text: Student's t — loc (median), scale, shape (ν, degrees of freedom)

metric.LCOP.text: Pre-tax levelized cost of the primary product (default).

metric.PBT.text: Payback time in years: the cumulative cash flow break-even year (aliases "PAYBACK", "PAYBACK_TIME").

metric.SIMPLE_PBT.text: Simple payback time in years: fixed capital over mean annual cash flow (aliases "SIMPLE_PAYBACK", "SIMPLE_PAYBACK_TIME").
